messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT ingested: service=runtime-gateway env=prod deploy=release-2026-02-17 error_rate=3.8% p95=1200ms p99=3400ms 502/504 surge. paging oncall @akash

maria: seeing the same in grafana, p95 jumped right after the release window. top traces show `kv_cache.miss` spikes and long tail on `dispatch`

akash: I’m on it. paging/devon for runtime help. disabling auto-batcher for now? :eyes:

devon: I can jump in — agree try to disable batching and reduce max-concurrency on the gateway to cut tail. also suggest routing subset of traffic to canary-1 (previous binary).

lee: customer-impact: ~2.1% of requests failing across EU region, a couple big tenants seeing 5%+. CS already flagged two support tickets.

runtime-eng: quick datapoint: kernel metrics show high kernel-sched wait for gpu driver, but more likely this is KV warmup + large prefix blocking. warmup not complete after shard rotation during deploy.

maria: rolling cut: can we flip routing to release-2026-02-16 for all non-SSR traffic? that should be compatible.

devon: ack. initiating route-shift to previous release for 20% -> 50% -> 100% until error rate stabilizes. if not stable, prepare fast rollback.

deploy-bot: route-shift job started: job_id=rs-4829981248 -> 20%

akash: after 30s 20% -> errors dropped to 1.4% but p99 still high. continuing to 50%.

support-lead: prepping customer note: short update to affected tenants that we're actively rolling back and will follow up with root cause.

devon: 50% -> error rate down to 0.6% p95=220ms p99=520ms. tail is much better. recommend full revert to be safe.

maria: initiating full rollback now (hot revert). command: `deploy rollback release-2026-02-16 --force --no-canary-warmup`

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: rollback_id=rb-4829981310 status=running

runtime-eng: also toggled kv-cache-debugging=on to collect sample keys for postmortem (small perf hit). please avoid heavy queries until rollback completes.

devon: monitor for 2m after rollback then we can unlock autoscaling and batching.

deploy-bot: rollback completed: rollback_id=rb-4829981310 status=success at 4829981368

akash: metrics: error_rate=0.2% p95=210ms p99=470ms across regions. marking incident mitigated.

pagerbot: Incident update: status=mitigated -> Severity reduced. Oncall handoff to SRE rotation for postmortem.

support-lead: CS note queued. will send short email with timeline and apology, offer follow-up sync for impacted tenants.

maria: creating incident ticket and assigning action items: 1) KV warmup gating on deploy 2) add canary ramp guard 3) improve telemetry for kv miss tracing 4) run load test for rolling deploy. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

devon: thanks — will stay on postmortem call in 30. good coordination. :thumbsup:

akash: handing off to next oncall. if anything regresses, page `#oncall` immediately.

pagerbot: Thread closed for now. Logs and traces attached in the incident runbook.
